findings.detail: Source explicitly describes an unwanted deeper kiss imposed by Darcy; «насильно поцеловала» conveys force but loses the specific nature of the kiss. Restore this non-graphic detail without eroticization.

source_anchor.quote: but Darcy grabbed his face and forced her tongue into his mouth.

translation_anchor.quote: но Дарси схватила его за лицо и насильно поцеловала.

findings.detail: «Поднял его на вытянутых здоровенных кулаках» is an unnatural and misleading account of lifting a boy by his T-shirt with clenched fists. Clearly preserve the clothing grip and lifting motion.

source_anchor.quote: Darren lifted the smaller boy up by his fake blood-stained t-shirt with meaty fists.

translation_anchor.quote: Даррен схватил паренька за заляпанную фальшивой кровью футболку и поднял его на вытянутых здоровенных кулаках.
